summary: Which mapping/site survives depends on input atom order

values.order_independent: same products for every spelling of the molecule
values.mapping_order_dependent: symmetric pattern: which end is which follows atom order (chematic, Open Babel)
values.site_order_dependent: several sites: which site survives follows atom order (BioTransformer, Ambit A8c)

cases.note: the same atom pair matches in two orders; the deleted end decides C vs CO
